t: A snap-together LoRa radio kit for off-grid text messaging with Meshtastic.
steps: Buy the kit from the RAKwireless store or a reseller such as Rokland. Choose the frequency band for your country.
Screw the antenna onto the radio before powering it on.
Plug the kit into a computer or charger with a USB-C cable.
Install the free Meshtastic app on your phone.
Pair the node with the app over Bluetooth and set your region.
Send a test message to a friend who also has a Meshtastic node.
Add a 3.7 volt lithium battery for use away from a wall plug.
Read the Meshtastic guide for WisBlock before adding extra modules.
meta: Open Board. From $24.99. A few stores.
